summary: CPS Technologies Corp. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a lease agreement with VMD Industrial II, LLC for an 80,000-square-foot facility in Attleboro, MA. The 12-year-10-month lease includes a construction period, rent abatement, base rent starting at $85,000/month escalating 3% annually, landlord contribution up to $3.2 million, a security deposit, and extension options. This is a routine operational real estate transaction, not a special situation.
